name: 2.5D Normal Sculptor sculpts directional bevels and rivet dimples with RNM blending
description: Verify sculpting directional tangent normal maps using the Normal Chisel and Rivet Stamp tools, configuring chisel bevel azimuth and incline, and composing normals with Reoriented Normal Mapping (RNM).

planSteps.description: Click the 'PixiBud AI' tab button in the right inspector panel
Verify the '2.5D Normal Chisel & Bas-Relief' section is visible with the interactive 3D Normal Sphere Gizmo
Click the '+ Add Dedicated Normal Layer' button
Verify a new dedicated normal layer is added to the active frame
Click the Normal Chisel tool button in the left toolbar (or press K on keyboard)
Carve several strokes across the canvas to lay down directional surface normal bevels
Click the Rivet Stamp tool button in the left toolbar (or press N on keyboard)
Click in several positions on the canvas to stamp spherical dome rivets
Verify the rivets and chisel bevels blend smoothly using Reoriented Normal Mapping without clipping RGB vector bounds
